links.outcome: Agent withholding writes on tampered patient-identity visits (tamper detection)
links.effect: GPT-4.1 withheld writing in 17.4% of header-swap runs; detection of MRN or age changes near zero. GPT-4.1-nano detected 4.4% of header swaps and <1% of MRN/age changes.
links.quote: Agents usually copied codes into tampered charts.

links.outcome: Agent detection of erroneous inputs and tool outputs rather than propagating them
links.effect: Agents usually wrote into tampered charts; GPT-5-chat never identified mismatches; other models rarely withheld writing.
links.quote: Clinical agents often fail to detect patient identity inconsistencies.

unlisted_practices: Explicit patient identity verification (MRN/age/header consistency checks) in agentic EHR-writing workflows
Agent abstention when uncertain about record integrity
Benchmarks treating record integrity as a primary outcome

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-based autonomous clinical agents in a simulated EHR environment on their intrinsic ability to detect patient identity faults without evaluating an external deployment safeguard or guardrail intervention.
